assumptions.summary: Known conspirator and non-conspirator labels may be used as fixed boundary conditions without intermediate guilt-probability terms.
Message headers and fifteen topic labels contain enough association information for prioritization.
Employees with similar person and topic interactions should lie near one another in Euclidean count-vector space.
Exactly one of five repeated-name pairs represents one employee because 83 names describe 82 employees.
Higher electric potential means closer network association to positive nodes and suspicious topics.
Sent and received topic messages can be weighted equally.
Topic-reference, direct node, and direct topic connections can be omitted without losing more value than their parameter cost.
Each additional parameter represents an additional assumption and increases overfit risk.
Voltage rank may guide investigation but is insufficient for prosecution.
A historical investigation share can serve as a conservative review-capacity proxy.
Full text would support LSI topic similarity and sentiment-based node links.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: The paper uses message sender, receiver, fifteen topic labels, seven known conspirators, and eight known non-conspirators.
The dataset contains 400 message headers among 83 listed names representing 82 employees.
318 of 400 messages involve unique employee pairs, motivating topic-level aggregation.
Topic 18 is treated as invalid after ambiguous preliminary clustering.
Each person becomes a 98-component vector: 83 person counts plus 15 topic counts.
Cii is replaced by the mean of the other entries in column i.
Beth nodes 14 and 38 are merged; node 7 Elsie is treated as known positive and the text calls node 27 unknown after referring to node 37.
People and topics become a bipartite conductance network; positive and negative labels receive fixed voltages.
Chris and Topic 1 are jointly changed for the paired scenario; ten leave-one-out cases release seven people and three topics.
A second identity scenario merges every repeated name and compares the top ranks.

dependency_graph.handoff: Clustering supplies local evidence for duplicate identities, topic handling, and feature selection.
The cleaned person-topic representation becomes the bipartite circuit.
The same circuit is rerun under changed labels and identity treatments.
Internally persistent ranks are passed to the cutoff and recommendation interface.
Base-case voltage ranking supplies the ordered investigation list.
Future topic and node similarities would add conductances only after new data and validation.

independent_extensions.summary: Acquire consented full text and timestamps, with provenance, privacy, and access controls.
Standardize count features and compare the artificial diagonal against explicit missing/self-feature handling.
Publish k-means run count, seeds, objective values, cluster stability, and an alternative clustering baseline.
Resolve every repeated identity with stable employee IDs and rerun all graph versions.
Publish the KCL/Laplacian system, boundary handling, uniqueness conditions, and numerical solver.
Estimate or sensitivity-test alpha through epsilon with independent labels and sparse-node shrinkage.
Rename voltage as an association-priority score and calibrate it against independent outcomes.
Report set overlap, rank correlation, calibration, and decision loss for every scenario.
Use nested holdout evaluation rather than label-reusing clustering support.
Choose review capacity from resources and explicit false-positive and false-negative costs.
Implement LSI and sentiment only after a documented corpus, annotation, reliability, and privacy protocol exists.
Require corroboration and legal authority before any ranked person is investigated.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: The Abstract exposes both models and the decision chain, but award status does not prove this organization caused success.
Explicit rejection of an overfit parameter grid makes the architecture choice inspectable without proving it optimal.
Publishing zeroed conductance terms shows restraint, though calibration is absent.
The paper distinguishes further investigation from prosecution, reducing semantic overreach without resolving legal authority.
A failed semantic attempt is disclosed before future repairs are proposed.
The recommendation is resource-bounded, but the historical threshold remains weak.

language_observations.summary: Human style comes from visible rejection, local repair, failed attempts, exact comparison, and bounded handoffs.
abstract previews two models and a decision: Preview the sparse-data obstacle, auxiliary clustering, electric ranking, robustness checks, and bounded recommendation.
legal stakes constrain model architecture: State evidentiary stakes, reject intermediate guilt assumptions, and select an architecture whose outputs remain screening priorities.
search-space arithmetic triggers a simpler design: Compare parameter combinations with possible labelings, identify accidental fit risk, then choose concurrent simple models.
sparse pair traffic triggers a topic representation: Quantify unique sender-receiver pairs, explain why pair frequency is unstable, and shift weight toward node-topic interactions.
visible ambiguity becomes a local cleanup rule: Expose repeated names or an invalid topic, compare local evidence, choose a working identity or exclusion rule, and retain the uncertainty.
an auxiliary model supports main-model choices: Use clustering to test duplicate identities and feature groups, then hand only the supported choices to the electric model.
an algorithmic limitation triggers repeated runs: Acknowledge the local optimum, vary random anchors, repeat runs, and retain the most frequent clustering.
a composition table determines a feature choice: Compare guilty and innocent composition across pair, topic, and combined feature sets, then select the cleaner separation.
candidate parameters are explicitly rejected: Name a plausible conductance, test its information value and invariance, then set its coefficient to zero.
physical intuition precedes a conductance rule: Map association strength to conductance, specify boundary voltages, solve unknown voltages, and interpret only as proximity-based priority.
a general formula narrows to a selected case: Display candidate sender, receiver, and reference terms, justify fixed coefficients, then publish the used special case.
rank becomes a bounded investigation action: Read an exact voltage or rank, state the sparse evidence behind it, reject prosecution-level interpretation, and recommend corroboration.
changed labels lead to a paired rerun: Modify one person and one topic label, retain the model, compare top sets and order, and distinguish conservation from shuffling.
leave-one-out tests address association dependence: Release each positive boundary condition, rerun all cases, count retained top-ranked people, and restate the association boundary.
identity inference is paired with an external check: Infer a manager identity from message patterns, then name directory, email, or phone evidence that could verify or correct it.
an unclear cutoff is replaced by an external capacity proxy: Admit threshold ambiguity, derive a conservative review share from an external case, and convert it to a resource-limited queue.
a failed semantic attempt becomes future work: Name the small-corpus failure and unsuccessful WordNet distance, then condition LSI and sentiment repairs on full text.
ranked results become a resource-bounded recommendation: List the next review subjects, combine them with known cases, disclose that the cutoff may fail, and continue only as resources allow.
a full ranking is moved to an appendix: Keep the main text focused on the decision set while preserving every ranked item and boundary label in an appendix.
each claimed strength exposes a tradeoff: Pair expressiveness, simplicity, or flexibility with omitted connections, saturated sparse nodes, and data requirements.

results_trace.summary: 318 of 400 messages use unique employee pairs, so pair frequency is too sparse for the intended inference.
The source selects the Beth pair as one identity and node 7 Elsie as the known positive.
Topic-only clustering places all seven known guilty people and three known innocent people in one 42-person cluster.
Dayi and Sheng reach one volt because they communicate only about suspicious topics; the paper limits this to further investigation.
Dolores ranks tenth of seventy-five unknown employees; the two Jeromes rank fifth and forty-third.
Twelve of the top fifteen names persist after changing Chris and Topic 1, while order and six names change.
Six people remain in the top ten across all ten leave-one-out conditions.
Merging repeated names replaces Jerome with Bariol in the top ten and moves merged Jerome to twentieth.
The historical proxy selects seventeen of eighty-two employees, leaving ten additional reviews after seven known cases.
The final recommendation lists ten additional workers and conditions further expansion on resources and new evidence.

source_quality.summary: Text covers all 23 pages; every page was read twice and visually reviewed. Abstract is present, no standalone general Introduction or literal Conclusion exists, and source identity/formula defects remain warnings.

title: Crime Ring Analysis with Electric Networks
unresolved_questions: The official problem statement is unavailable, so the task is reconstructed only from this paper.
Abstract claims about separation, robustness, and recommendation are internal previews without independent reproduction.
The 1331/1024 comparison illustrates accidental fit but is not a formal capacity or generalization bound.
Only message headers and topic labels are available; full text, timestamps, and provenance are absent.
The data have 318 unique pairs among 400 messages, limiting frequency estimation and temporal interpretation.
Topic 18 is discarded after ambiguous clustering without a frozen exclusion rule or sensitivity result.
The 98 raw count features are not standardized, and the artificial Cii column average changes the geometry.
K-means has random local optima, but enough runs is not quantified and no seed or convergence inventory is supplied.
The source says node 37 Elsie supports the identity decision but then labels node 27 Elsie unknown; this is a source typo.
Absence of Beth-to-Beth messages is weak evidence that nodes 14 and 38 are one person.
Cluster composition reuses the same representation and labels, so it is auxiliary co-validation rather than independent evidence.
The circuit's Kirchhoff/Laplacian linear system is omitted, preventing full reproduction of unknown voltages.
Alpha and beta are fixed at one while gamma, delta, and epsilon are set to zero without calibration or broad sensitivity analysis.
Generic biological transfer is speculative and adds training and physical assumptions absent from the crime data.
Sparse nodes connected only to suspicious topics can saturate at one volt even with very little traffic.
Voltage and guilt terminology overstates a proximity-based investigation-priority score.
Manager involvement is inferred partly from message volume and position, risking role prejudice and circular interpretation.
The 12-of-15 scenario overlap has no rank correlation, calibration, or held-out decision metric.
Leave-one-out reports six people always in the top ten but no aggregate error, rank-correlation, or uncertainty interval.
Repeated-name sensitivity merges identities under an assumption and still lacks external identity truth.
The 20 percent cutoff transfers 592 investigations from an extreme 3,200-employee case and is not calibrated to present costs.
The source-derived review count is 17 of 82 and ten additional workers; this is a resource proxy, not a guilt threshold.
The WordNet plus breadth-first semantic attempt failed, while LSI remains conditional on unavailable full text.
LSI inner product and sentiment conductances are proposed future repairs, not implemented evidence.
The recommendation omits uncertainty propagation, privacy, legal authority, false-positive cost, and stopping criteria.
Delores in the statement/recommendation conflicts with Dolores in result tables.
Appendix A assigns node 38 to both Paul and merged Beth while node 14 Beth disappears, conflicting with the main text.
No executable code, frozen data, software versions, seeds, runtime, or machine-readable outputs are supplied.
